Who are we?
We are Lottie Gross and Steph Dyson, two travel writers who have authored guidebooks for Rough Guides and DK, penned opinion pieces for The Telegraph, written features for The Times and, between us, travelled hundreds of thousands of miles around the world.

Why sign up?
Because we provide insider scoops on which editors are commissioning, we’ll seek out calls for travel pitches and tell you where to send your ideas, and we’ll offer genuinely practical, actionable advice to help you succeed as a travel writer.

Each month, we’ll explore a different topic or issue and deep-dive into the subject to offer you a game plan to help grow your portfolio, and your bank balance.

Name: 5N Networks Ltd
Description:
Every passenger on a 300-seat aircraft wants to stream live TV. Starlink delivers between 250 and 400Mbps, roughly the same as your 5G mobile device. The problem: streaming live TV to every person from one shared phone connection, is not going to work. That's the LEO Paradox — and it's why most airlines still can't offer live TV in the air.

5N Networks solves it.

Our proprietary software layer sits between the satellite link and passengers' devices. Using browser-based mesh distribution, a single incoming stream is shared peer-to-peer across the cabin. The result: all 300 passengers can stream live TV simultaneously — for the bandwidth cost of one.

Proven in the air. Not in a lab.

In December 2023, we ran a live trial with a major Southeast Asian carrier using Panasonic Avionics infrastructure. Available bandwidth: just 5 Mbps. With 5N running a test of a 1Mbps feed, 50 simultaneous users consumed only 1.47 Mbps total — a 97% reduction versus standard delivery of 50Mbps. 

TRL-9 validated: flight-proven, operational, ready to deploy.

Software-only. No hardware. No STC. Deploy in days.

5N integrates with any IFE system — Panasonic, Thales, Burrana, BYOD — via a single URL. No aircraft downtime. No weight penalty. No supplemental type certificate. Airlines and IFC providers go live in days, not months.

With simplified commercial models to suit all customer types, we can enhance existing services or offer easier solutions for new and legacy systems.

Our team brings 120+ years of combined experience across broadcast media, satellite connectivity, and enterprise IT — from O2, Ooredoo, CNN, Telenor, T-Mobile, and Vodafone.

Headquartered in Hong Kong. Distributed across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.

At that time it was a gathering of media misfits who decided that rather than griping about the state of the industry they would stage their own screenings in cafes, pubs and disused buildings, fusing together the isolated and disenchanted fragments of the underground media. 

The Low/No Budget film genre is the source of so much talent and creativity, but the films need a place to be shown. Not a sterile, unfriendly “arthouse” but an inclusive, relaxed, open environment where the audience can watch, chat, discuss the film and meet other film makers.

Since its humble beginnings Exploding Cinema has grown into an institution of the independent film scene, boosting the careers of hundreds of new filmmakers whose work would otherwise have gone unnoticed. We have toured the UK and abroad, putting on shows to a worldwide audience. in 2020 we expanded online and recently our 34 year history has been documented in a book 'BOOM' detailing the inception, growth and blossoming of a cultural legend that is still going to this day.

Name: Moore Squared Communications
Description:
When we say we understand investors, we mean it. We have spent years talking to and working in investment organisations. We understand how rapid changes in recent years have caused asset managers’ client pool to shrink. We know the current government’s suggested pension reforms will have unexpected and unsettling consequences.
Natasha spent a decade working in communications in the asset management sector while Charlotte built a freelance journalist career specialising in how pension schemes allocate assets. 
A decade of working in corporate communications at asset managers means Natasha understands the pressures those departments face. Charlotte has conducted thousands of interviews with asset managers and owners – as well as their advisors – giving her a profound insight into the industry.
We know how regulation and market structures shape the way institutional investors allocate their assets. We have tracked how rapidly the market has changed and the challenges this throws up for both asset managers and owners.
This adds up to a combined 50 years’ experience of what good investment communications should look like. We are passionate about helping you to build deeper connection with your existing and potential clients.
The key to building those relationships is to show you understand your clients’ challenges and to demonstrate you are the solution. This sounds obvious but in our experience the industry too often focuses on what it can sell rather than what it can solve.
We create bespoke communication strategies – and oversee plans – so you can build those long-term relationships. We provide the opportunities for those must-have face-to-face interactions.
Sustainable investment is important to both of us and we know it is vital to have the right  philosophies and processes in place if you want to be credible. Communication is key. A good sustainable investor who talks about it badly will lose business to a less adept sustainable investor who talks about it well.

Name: In Our Defence Podcast
Description:
In Our Defence is a podcast created by two aspiring Barristers - India and Lou - to document their journey to the Bar of England and Wales. Each week they discuss a different topic - from A-Levels and Law degrees to the Bar Course and Pupillage. 

They start the episodes with a segment discussing their “Best of the Week” covering the most interesting pieces of legal news that week. They then go on to discuss that weeks topic in detail, giving the advice that they have acquired throughout their journey.

This lighthearted and fun legal podcast is intended to help prospective Bar students/legal professionals and bring you comfort on your personal legal career journey!

At 360 News Orbit, our goal is simple: to make world news organized, reliable, and accessible—so that anyone, anywhere, can understand the bigger picture at a glance.
